resources.string: 不得不: have no choice but to
不但 / 不仅…而且…: not only… but also…
无论 / 不管…都…: no matter…, (always)…
A 不如 B: A is not as good as B; it would be better to…
不用: there is no need to
别 / 不要 + verb: don’t (do it)
但是 / 可是 / 不过: but, however
虽然…但是 / 可是…: although…, (still)…
因为…所以…: because… (so)…: the reason, then the result
如果 / 要是…(的话)…就…: if…, then…
只要…就…: as long as…, (then)…
只有…才…: only if…, (only then)…
既然…就…: since (given that)…, then…
即使 / 就算…也…: even if…, still…
连…都 / 也…: even…
除了…(以外): except…; besides…
对(于)…来说: for (someone), from their point of view
不是 A 而是 B: not A, but B
看起来 / 听起来: looks like, sounds like, seems
有点儿 + adjective: a bit (usually something unwanted)
一点儿: a little (adjective + 一点儿 = a bit more…)
越来越 + adjective: more and more…
越 A 越 B: the more A, the more B
一边 A 一边 B: doing A and B at the same time
快要 / 就要…了: about to happen, very soon
在 / 正在 + verb: doing it right now (in progress)
Verb + 一下: do it briefly (have a quick look, wait a moment)
Verb + 来 / 去 (…): the direction of the action (来 toward the speaker, 去 away)
Verb + 得 / 不 + result: can / can’t (听不懂 = can’t understand)
Verb + result: shows how the action ends (做完 = finish, 听懂 = understand, 找到 = find)
让 / 叫 + someone + verb: let or make someone do something
以 A 为 B: take A as B (formal)
吗: turns a sentence into a yes/no question
呢: and what about…?; softens a question; or an action still going on
是: is, am, are (links two nouns: 我是学生)
有: have; there is
在: at, in (a place); or be at a place
很: very (often just links the subject to an adjective)
太 (…了): too…; or so… (了 adds feeling)
都: all, both (comes before the verb)
也: also, too (comes before the verb)
和: and (joins nouns, not sentences); with
Question word: what, who, where, how, how many, why (stands where the answer would be)
…的时候: when…, at the time of…
Place word after the noun: 桌子上 = on the table, 房间里 = in the room
请 + verb: please (do)
会: can (a learned skill); will probably
能: can (be able to, or be allowed to)
想 + verb: want to, would like to
的: links a describing word or an owner to a noun (我的书 = my book)
Verb + 了: the action is completed
Verb + 过: have done it before (an experience)
Verb + 着: a lasting state or an action going on (穿着 = wearing)
Verb + 得 + description: how (well) it is done (跑得很快)
A 比 B + adjective: A is more… than B
最: the most
就: then; right away; exactly; only (stresses that it is soon or easy)
已经 (…了): already
给: give; for, to (给他打电话 = phone him)
对: to, toward, about (对…感兴趣); or correct
从: from (a place or a time); 从…到…: from… to…
离: the distance from (A 离 B 很远 = A is far from B)
往: toward (a direction)
一起: together (跟…一起 = together with)
还: still; also; even more (还有 = there is also)
再: again (in the future); then (先…再…)
非常 / 特别 / 真 / 挺: very, really (how strong the adjective is)
可以: may, can (permission or possibility)
要: want; need to; will (soon)
吧: a suggestion (let’s…) or checking (…right?)
常常 / 经常 / 总是: how often (often, usually, always)
…以前 / …以后: before… / after… (comes after the event)
第 + number: an order number (第一 = first)
每 (+ measure word): every (often with 都)
了 at the end: something has changed or is new now
Verb 不 verb: a yes/no question (去不去 = going or not?)
Doubled verb (看看, 试一试): do it a little, give it a try
把 + object + verb + result: does something to the object (the object comes before the verb)
被: passive, the subject receives the action (often something unwanted)
Description + 地 + verb: how the action is done (慢慢地走)
更: even more
先 (…再 / 然后…): first (…, then…)
然后: then, after that
还是: or (in questions); still; had better
或者: or (in statements)
才: only then, not until (later or harder than expected)
又: again (it already happened again); 又 A 又 B: both A and B
比较: fairly, rather; to compare
只: only (before the verb)
一定: surely, definitely; must
终于: finally (after waiting or effort)
马上: right away, immediately
一直: all the time, continuously; straight ahead
其实: actually, in fact
刚 / 刚刚: just (a moment ago); 刚才: a moment ago
应该: should, ought to
必须: must, have to
需要: need (to)
愿意: be willing to
为了: in order to; for the sake of
关于: about, on the topic of
跟: with, and (跟…一起 = together with)
A 跟 / 和 B 一样: A is the same as B
好像: it seems, as if
这么 / 那么 (+ adjective): so…, like this / like that
啊 / 呀 / 啦: add feeling (surprise, excitement, a softer tone)
是…的: stresses when, where or how something happened
一 A 就 B: as soon as A, (then) B
于是: so, and then (what happened next)
多么 + adjective!: how…! (strong feeling)
原来: originally; so it turns out (you just realized)
到底: on earth (in questions); after all
甚至: even (going further than expected)
否则 / 不然: otherwise, or else
竟然 / 居然: unexpectedly, to your surprise
难道…?: surely not…? (a question that expects no)
尽管: although; feel free to
随着: along with, as (something changes)
反正: anyway, in any case
毕竟: after all
未必: not necessarily
简直: simply, practically (strong feeling)
万一: if by any chance (something bad)
总之: in short, anyway
至于: as for…
与其 A 不如 B: rather than A, it is better to B
宁可: would rather (even at a cost)
何必…?: why bother…? (there is no need)
以免: so as to avoid
以便: so that, to make it easier to
从而: thus, thereby
固然: admittedly, it is true that… (but)
况且 / 何况: besides, moreover; let alone
们: makes a word for people plural (朋友们 = friends)
用 + thing + verb: do something with or using it
为 + someone: for someone, on behalf of (为你高兴 = happy for you)
向 / 朝: toward, facing (向我走来 = come toward me)
以为: thought (usually wrongly), assumed
而: and, yet, while (joins two ideas, more formal)
并: and also; 并不 / 并没有: not at all, actually not
由: by (who does it); from (由我负责 = I am in charge)
所 + verb: what… (formal; 我所知道的 = what I know)
只是: just, only; but (a softer 但是)
由于: because of, due to (formal)
根据: according to; 通过: through, by means of; 按照: following (the rules)
于: at, in, to, from (formal written Chinese)
以: with, by means of, as (formal)
之: the formal 的 (三分之一 = one third; …之一 = one of…)
Measure word: number or this / that + measure word + noun (一本书, 这个人)
不: not (now, the future, habits, and with adjectives)
没 / 没有: did not, have not (past actions); 没有 + noun: not have
